bagPolicy.summary: Small bags under 12 inches are allowed with bag check. Large bags and backpacks are not permitted, and lockers are available inside the venue.
allowed: Small bags under 12 inches (with bag check)
bagPolicy.quote: Small bags under 12 inches are allowed with bag check.

parking.summary: The Rock Box parking lot is across from the venue's front entrance and is first come, first served.
parking.quote: Our parking lot is located across from the front entrance of the venue and is available on a first-come, first-served basis.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by The Rock Box. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: The Rock Box has a full bar serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks.
concessions.quote: Yes. The Rock Box has a full bar serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages.

accessibility.summary: The Rock Box hasn't published accessibility details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not allowed once you leave during an event.
reEntry.quote: No. Re-entry is not permitted once you leave the venue during an event.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets online through the event listing or at the door, and buying ahead is highly recommended. Age limits vary by show: most are all ages, while some are 18+ or 21+.
ticketPickup.quote: Tickets can be purchased online through the event listing or at the door.

gates.summary: Door times vary by show, and your entrance depends on the stage. The front entrance leads to the Echo and Vibes stages, while the back and side entrances lead to the Underground and Backyard stages.
gates.quote: The front entrance accesses the Echo and Vibes stages.
